programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u002/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row)]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(len(grid)))]
    top, bottom = rows[0], rows[-1] + 1
    left, right = cols[0], cols[-1] + 1
    height, width = bottom - top, right - left
    return [row[left:left + width // 2] for row in grid[top:top + height // 2]]
